title: Module Lattice Security (Part III): Structured CVP Distance on the Log-Unit Lattice
summary: We prove that the $L^2$ CVP distance from a random short ring element to the log-unit lattice of $\Q(ζ_{2^k})$ converges to $\fracπ{2\sqrt{6}}\sqrt{n}$ as $n=2^{k-1}\to\infty$. We then show that this target lies inside the Voronoi cell of the origin for $k\ge 4$. For the $L^\infty$ norm, the maximum over $n$ sub-Gaussian coordinates yields $O(\sqrt{\log n})$ which translates into a sub-polynomial approximation factor for the Short Generator Problem.
